finding.claim: slug drops every non-ASCII letter instead of folding it, so 'Café état' becomes caf-tat.md.

fixes.change: Square brackets in a title become parentheses in the index link text, titles are NFKD-normalised before slugging so accented letters keep their base letter, and a description's whitespace including newlines collapses to single spaces.
Tests for a bracketed title passing kmctl check, an accented title's file name, a newline in a description; r1's test now asserts every kind's path and title.
